rationale: fastdiff_wdm_wavelet_constrained-claude-agentic: val_n=200, seed=42, fd_recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/fast_diffusion_wavelet_breast.pt, fd_recon_steps=8, fd_recon_init=fbp, fd_recon_init_t=0.005, fd_recon_eta=1.0, fd_recon_dc=1, fd_recon_dc_n_cg=25, fd_recon_dc_relax=1.0, dataset_kind=breast_ct, rationale=iter-10 DC-STRENGTH (n_cg up further), breast-native wavelet CONSTRAINED, val=200. SIX-BOX: (1) PRIOR: BREAKTHROUGH iter-9 (init_t0.005/n_cg15) hr=0.0695 (PSNR 36.95/RMSE 4.85e-3) CLEARED baseline 36.32/5.21e-3 -- more CG iters crossed it (iter-8 n_cg5 was RMSE 5.94e-3, hr=0). Direction confirmed: low init_t (prior-light) + strong CG-DC. (2) FAILURE MODE at iter-8: under-converged CG (n_cg5) left the recon just below the FBP; n_cg15 converged enough to beat it. (3) ONE KNOB: fd_recon_dc_n_cg 15 -> 25 (drive CG closer to the exact 128-view LSQ solution). (4) HYPOTHESIS: more CG iters lower RMSE further (the LSQ solution beats the regularized FBP) -> hr rises above 0.0695. FALSIFIER: if hr plateaus/drops, the CG has converged and 128-view LSQ noise amplification caps the gain -> pivot to raising init_t slightly so the wavelet prior can regularize the LSQ noise (prior+DC synergy). (5) BUDGET: n_cg25 ~4x CG cost of base, still well inside 20min. (6) iter-11 on landing.
